articles.title: South Korea's Kospi swings from bear to bull-market territory in just over a month on AI trade
articles.description: South Korean stocks rallied on Thursday, pushing the benchmark Kospi into a technical bull market.

articles.title: Oil rises on worries over supply disruptions as spill near Oman worsens
articles.description: News of recent deadly attacks on vessels in the Gulf of Oman and the Red Sea drove oil higher. An oil spill near Oman continued to worsen.

articles.title: EVs dominate China’s car market: 5 takeaways from the country's latest auto sales data
articles.description: The China Passenger Car Association released data Tuesday showing penetration of new energy vehicles rose in July. Tesla's Model Y remained popular.

articles.title: Japan wholesale inflation eases slightly to 7.2%, undershooting expectations

articles.title: Goldman says Japan's $1 trillion of reserves leaves 'plenty of capacity' for further yen interventions
articles.description: Japan has enough cash at its disposal for a couple more rounds of yen-buying on the scale of last month's intervention, Goldman Sachs says.

articles.title: ASX shareholder plans to sue former directors over failed blockchain project

articles.title: Inside India newsletter: Why global funds are flocking to GIFT City in Modi’s home state
articles.description: Favorable regulations, a growing local investor base, and tax holidays are giving momentum to India's GIFT City.

articles.title: Trump sued over Truth Social advance access sale
articles.description: The lawsuit, filed in U.S. District Court in Manhattan, notes that Trump's posts on his own social media site often move financial markets.

articles.description: Qualifying new customers can receive full reimbursement, including fees, if they notify both the operator and law enforcement within 30 days.

articles.title: Where gold price is headed next as Fed rate hike and inflation odds change direction

articles.description: A Kansas City security researcher ran 31 million tests to teach a model how to paint camouflage for the algorithm age.
